79d85fd7-7022-4750-b4e1-4857c14d192c.name: Remaining cells in box (as Cell(0,1) and Cell(1,0) were already tested) cannot be 1 (in this case is Cell(1,1))

f5dea10f-b9f2-481f-9821-52176c8f1070.name: CNF only understands True or False. So the triple row, column, value are converted into a single integer to represent each cell with a value in the board. The formula used is reversible and human readable id = 100×(row+1)+10×(column+1)+value

e2197a62-b03e-4f51-8ad8-2d6933135b4b.name: To simplify this diagram we are only validating Cell(0,0) however this must be done for each cell in the board

43955e98-d256-41c2-811c-70a34da3e18b.name: This CNF formula is the conjunction of the following clauses: C1) Given clue; C2) Row uniqueness, C3) Column uniqueness; C4) Box uniqueness

ba3e8858-45be-4acc-9d1e-988980838248.name: This holds the conjunction of all clauses

cc16000d-a002-48b0-a54a-691a5cc5d2b2.name: This holds all the disjunction of all the literals

85f2cca2-78bf-4b3a-8975-b6af6168bb39.name: This id encodes the cell properties (value, column and row) to be represented as a unique variable

281d3355-c6a2-47e5-b8a9-c468f26c9281.constraint:
context Clause
inv UniqueLiteral:
  self.literal->forAll(l1, l2 | 
    l1 <> l2 implies (l1.variable <> l2.variable or l1.isNegated <> l2.isNegated)
  )

034c920d-be8d-4574-86ee-bb75e3ae8eda.constraint:
context Clause
inv NoTautology: 
  self.literal->forAll(l1, l2 | 
    (l1 <> l2 and l1.variable = l2.variable) 
    implies l1.isNegated = l2.isNegated
  )
